command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- os ---'
cat /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '--- boot-id ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- module state ---'
if grep -q '^usb_storage ' /proc/modules; then grep '^usb_storage ' /proc/modules; else printf '%s\n' 'usb_storage not loaded'; fi

for f in /etc/modprobe.d/*.conf /etc/modprobe.d/*; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; printf '### %s\n' "$f"; sed -n '/usb[-_]storage/p' "$f"; done
printf '%s\n' '--- initramfs tooling ---'
command -v mkinitfs || true
printf '%s\n' '--- root filesystem ---'
mount | sed -n '1,5p'

command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- persistent policy ---'
cat /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf
printf '%s\n' '--- live state before negative load test ---'
if grep -q '^usb_storage ' /proc/modules; then grep '^usb_storage ' /proc/modules; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'usb_storage absent'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- direct load test ---'
if modprobe usb_storage; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: direct module load unexpectedly succeeded'; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'direct module load refused as configured'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- final live state ---'
if grep -q '^usb_storage ' /proc/modules; then grep '^usb_storage ' /proc/modules; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'usb_storage remains absent'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- initramfs policy inclusion ---'
if command -v lsinitramfs >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsinitramfs /boot/initramfs-lts | grep 'etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf'; else printf '%s\n' 'lsinitramfs unavailable'; fi
